nodes.label: icon-512.png (GymTracker app icon, 512x512)
nodes.rationale: Fully opaque 512x512 PNG: a full-bleed near-black square with a centered orange dumbbell, no baked-in rounded corners and no transparency, so each OS can apply its own icon mask. Declared with the default 'any' purpose in the VitePWA manifest (vite.config.ts manifest.icons, line 50); PWA installability guidance calls for 192px and 512px icons, so this is the large install/splash artwork. Sibling renditions of the same artwork: icon-192.png, maskable-512.png (glyph shrunk to 60% of the width to stay inside the Android safe zone) and apple-touch-icon.png (180px iOS home-screen icon, linked from index.html).

nodes.label: Orange dumbbell glyph (logo mark)
nodes.rationale: Flat, single-colour dumbbell silhouette: a short horizontal handle bar between two tall rounded plates, each flanked by a smaller outer plate, perfectly symmetric and centered (x 64-447, y 156-355 of 512, i.e. 75% of the canvas width and 39% of its height). Simple geometry and rounded corners keep it recognisable when downscaled to 192px/180px or cropped by an OS mask, and it signals the app's purpose (strength-training logging) without any text. The same dumbbell metaphor is reused in-app as the Workout tab icon.

nodes.label: Brand palette: near-black #0B0F14 + orange #F97316
nodes.rationale: Two-colour, high-contrast scheme (about 6.9:1 contrast ratio). Near-black #0B0F14 fills about 83% of the pixels and equals the Tailwind token 'bg' (tailwind.config.js), the PWA manifest theme_color/background_color (vite.config.ts) and the theme-color meta tag in index.html; orange #F97316 (about 14% of pixels, Tailwind orange-500) equals the Tailwind token 'primary', which the TabBar also uses for the active tab. Reusing the in-app tokens makes the launcher icon, the PWA splash background and the UI read as one brand, but the values are duplicated literals rather than imports, so changing one means updating the others by hand.
